title: Hello Scripter
description: Create a C# script that prints a welcome message and a countdown in the Console.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Write your first script to display text in the Console.

1. Create a new C# script named `ConsoleGreeter`.
2. Open it and inside the `Start()` method, add a line to print "Welcome to Unity Scripting!" using `Debug.Log`.
3. Add three more `Debug.Log` lines that print "3...", "2...", "1..." sequentially.
4. Inside `Update()`, add a comment `// Your code will go here later` but do not add any runtime code yet.
5. Attach the script to any GameObject (e.g., Main Camera or an Empty).
6. Enter Play mode and observe the Console. You should see four messages in order.
7. Take a screenshot of the Console showing the messages.

**Bonus:** Use `Debug.LogWarning` for the "1..." message to make it yellow.
hints: Remember, `Start()` runs once when the script starts. All logs in Start will appear together.
To attach a script, drag it from the Project window onto the object in the Hierarchy.
expectedOutput: Console output: Welcome to Unity Scripting! / 3... / 2... / 1... (the last in yellow if bonus done).
